permit.first: For an Employment Permit, the post advertised in two leading newspapers, with the selection outcome, and an employment contract or letter of offer

sources.title: Department of Immigration (Zambia), Permit Types
sources.said: An Employment Permit is issued to a foreigner who enters the country to take up employment for a period exceeding six (06) months. It can be extended for periods up to a maximum of 10 years. … All applicants should remain outside Zambia until the permit has been approved. Further, only an Employer, a Practising Lawyer and an Immigration Consult can apply for Employment Permits on behalf of a prospective expatriate. … Employment contract or Letter of offer; … Original Press advertisements which have appeared in two leading newspapers in A5 size. … A Temporary Employment Permit is issued to any business visitor who intends to remain in Zambia for a period exceeding thirty (30) days. The validity of the permit should not exceed six (6) months within a period of twelve (12) months. Requirements for issuance Covering letter from the institution doing business with applicant; Duly completed application form (Form 25); … Requirements for renewal/extension Covering letter from the employer indicating the reasons for extension; Duly completed application form (Form 11); and Prescribed fee.
